shayari:
Khamoshi bhi bahut kuch keh jaati hai,
Bas samajhne wala koi chahiye.
title: Kuch Baatein Dil Mein Reh Jaati Hain

shayari:
Kabhi waqt kam pad jata hai,
To kabhi raaste lambay lagte hain.
Zindagi ki is daud mein,
Hum khud se hi thoda peeche chhoot jate hain.
Par seekh rahe hain har din,
Safar ka maza lena bhi zaroori hai.
title: Zindagi Ka Safar Aur Hum | Heart Touching Shayari

shayari:
Tujhe bhoolne ki koshish mein,
Har din thoda aur toot jate hain.
Laga tha waqt bhar dega har zakhm,
Par purane panne aaj bhi rulate hain.
Tera zikr jab bhi hota hai kahin,
Hum muskura kar baat badal jaate hain.
title: Tujhe Bhool Na Paye 💔 | Sad Heartbreak Shayari | Emotional Line
